Audit the support and assumptions of an intervention design

Source: R/research-diagnostics.R
lamp_design_audit.Rd

Reports missing submissions, pre/post support and detection-sensitive outcomes. A clean data audit does not establish causal identification; intervention assignment, contemporaneous changes and spillovers still require substantive evidence.

Usage

lamp_design_audit(
  panel,
  treatment = NULL,
  outcomes = "crime_total",
  min_pre = 6L,
  min_post = 6L
)

Arguments

panel

A lamp_panel.

treatment

Optional dated lamp_treatment() object.

outcomes

Outcome columns under consideration.

min_pre, min_post

Minimum observed months per treated area before and after adoption for the support audit.

Value

A list with issues (check, status, detail), area_support, and summary. Statuses describe data support or required arguments, not certification of causality.

See also

Other diagnostics: lamp_effect_summary(), lamp_elasticity_robustness(), lamp_placebo(), lamp_pretrends(), lamp_trend_sensitivity()

Examples

sim <- lamp_simulate(design = "event", seed = 1)
lamp_design_audit(sim)
